newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm to supply Russian wireless firm.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm to supply Russian wireless firm.

text.p: Qualcomm Inc said it is in talks to supply a Russian telecommunication concern with a wireless system that can serve up to 300,000 customers.
Qualcomm, a maker of wireless communication gear, also will plan and install the system for JSC Personal Communications of Moscow, the company said.
Other terms of the multi-year contract were not disclosed.
Shares of Qualcomm rose 3/8 to 40-1/4 in early afternoon Nasdaq trading.
Qualcomm, based in San Diego, will begin installing the network, based on its CDMA wireless technology, in early 1997 with commercial service slated for the middle of the year.
There is a high demand for wireless telephones in the Moscow area, the companies said.
